business_summary: Kennametal is a US industrial manufacturer whose core expertise is tungsten carbides, ceramics and super-hard materials for metal cutting and extreme-wear applications. It maintains an internal tungsten scrap-recycling capability that reclaims carbide scrap back into its own production, a working domestic recycling and refining step, alongside its core tungsten carbide intermediate and end-product manufacturing. FY2026 revenue was $2.36B, up from $1.97B in FY2025.

exposure_summary.narrative: KMT sits on three links (recycling-and-refining-capacity-buildout, us-tungsten-processing-and-carbide-production, defense-and-industrial-tungsten-demand), all sourced to the same FY2026 10-K Business section. Its role is confirmed on the two carbide/recycling links; the defense-demand link carries no dated evidence yet of a specific defense/ordnance end-use, only the general industrial carbide role, per the mapping's own role text.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No tungsten-specific or black-mass-specific revenue percentage is separately disclosed; Kennametal reports as one industrial segment set in its 10-K.
